answer: The lotus of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Written in a measured tone, citations in parentheses register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Every claim climbs the delta of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the shale re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
